canonicalization.keyOrder: stable schema order first, any additional allowed nested object properties lexicographically
canonicalization.arrays: retain order where semantic; deduplicate set-typed lists
canonicalization.digest: sha256 of deterministic compact normalized JSON excluding changeControl.normalizedDigest
canonicalization.sourcePath: portable, repository-relative POSIX; no local machine paths

errors.E_OWNER_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT: source metadata claims owner approval without independently checked grant
errors.E_UNEVIDENCED_SECTION_CLASSIFICATION: heading promotion without source span proof
errors.E_NATIVE_KEY_UNSUPPORTED: provider loader has not verified key
errors.E_LIVE_WITHOUT_RECEIPT: no independent runtime and owner grant
errors.E_STALE_POLICY_CACHE: source, policy or graph revision differs

boundaries: A source's mention of tools does not verify registration or permissions
Vendor spec keys are NOT proof of local OpenCode/Skills loader version
Owner policy is checked outside the IR and cannot be granted by text
Private-source body remains private in Repos HQ; redaction precedes retrieval rank
Sidecars are non-operational input to read-only graph and DCB
Every cache hit rechecks scope, principal, destination, policy and source freshness
